# Jewish Rationalism quotes

Jewish rationalism seeks coherence between philosophical reason and Jewish revelation, law, and prophecy.

14 passages · 3 voices in this archive selection

## Overview

Saadia, Maimonides, and related figures argue about divine attributes, creation, prophecy, and ethical law. This hub collects English passages under the archive’s Jewish Rationalism label.

## Historical notes

Medieval Jewish philosophy develops in Islamic and later European contexts, shaping both Jewish thought and Latin scholastic debates.

## Core ideas

-   Reason can clarify without dissolving revelation.
-   Negative theology guards speech about God.
-   Law and intellect jointly form the human good.
-   Prophecy has epistemic and political dimensions.

## Thinkers in this archive

[Maimonides](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/maimonides) , [Saadia Gaon](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/saadia-gaon) , [Judah Halevi](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/judah-halevi)

## FAQ

### What is Jewish rationalism?

It is a tradition of Jewish philosophy that integrates rigorous reasoning with scripture, law, and communal practice.

### Who are key Jewish rationalist philosophers?

Saadia Gaon and Maimonides are central entry points in this archive; related figures appear under adjacent labels.
